  • Package model.description

    • Class model.description.DCursor

      class DCursor extends Rectangle2D.Double implements Serializable

      • Serialized Fields

        • advance
          double advance
          The advancement when typing this glyph's cursor. See FontMetrics. Remember that it can be an pre calculated average and it could be real depending on if the cursor is filled with a glyph or not.
        • erase
          boolean erase
          If this cursor should be erased or not. It is only a marker.
        • reference
          Point2D.Double reference
          The typographical reference point, the write point of the glyph. See FontMetrics. Remember that it can be an pre calculated average and it could be real depending on if the cursor is filled with a glyph or not.
        • value
          Formal value
          The value carried by and represented by this cursor. Remember that values should reside and be accesssed only here.
